sloka: विसृज्य च महाबाहुर्ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान् ।भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः प्रमुमोद सुखं सुखी ।। ७.४१.१ ॥
transliteration: visṛjya ca mahābāhurṛkṣavānararākṣasān ।bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rāmaḥ pramumoda sukhaṁ sukhī ।। 7.41.1 ॥

translations.english: And the mighty-armed Rama, having dismissed the bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas, was very happy and rejoiced greatly along with his brothers.
